hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (Ada Lovelace, sm_89)
result: FULL RESIDUE — every word in Kernel B reads back 0xCAFEBABE in all 1000 same-SM trials.
module6_framing: Residue is fully observable when the subsequent kernel is co-resident on the same SM — co-residency is forced in this experiment to demonstrate the window. This is in-process cross-kernel shared-memory persistence, NOT cross-tenant LeftoverLocals on NVIDIA.
limitation_coResidency: Diff-SM was 0/1000 because single-block __launch_bounds__(32,1) launches almost always land on the same SM back-to-back. Co-residency is forced, not a natural statistical rate.
limitation_toolchain: Compiled with CUDA 12.8 / gcc-14 in WSL2 Kali Linux 2026.1. CUDA 13.3 toolkit incompatible with driver 573.22. One-time patch to cuda-12.8 math_functions.h required for glibc 2.42 compat.
paired_control: results/phase0_control.json — Kernel B only, no Kernel A: 0/4096000 non-zero words, 0/4096000 pattern hits.
